notes.general_comments:
The questions for which most candidates selected the correct answer were 1, 2, 5, 8, 9, 21, 24 and 27.
These questions were answered correctly by 80% or more of the candidates. They covered different parts of
the syllabus and were set to test different skills.
The questions for which the fewest candidates selected the correct answer were 3, 11, 20, and 28. These
questions were answered correctly by 28% or fewer candidates. The rest of the questions gave results which
were well within the levels expected.
